name: drop-zone
title: Drop zone
description: A place that receives files, by drop or by picking: a sunk tray whose edge lights while files are dragged in the window, sinks and says 'Let go to attach' with files over it, refuses a file it won't take with a shake, and comes back up on the object spring when they land.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/drop-zone.md. SwiftUI: MetalDropZone in the MetalUI Swift package.
